_help: The buff bar at the top right of the HUD: the live buff icons side by side, no frame and no padding. right = the right edge of the last icon (the bar grows to the left), top = the top edge of the icons. iconPitch = the distance from one icon to the next (32 is the icon width: they touch), maxCount = how many buffs the bar holds (the official maxCount is 10). timeRight/timeBottom = the space between the time left and the icon edge, shadow = the shadow offset of the time text. The icon size (32) is an art size, it stays in the code.
